nav.title: Dashboard
nav.body: Open home from the sidebar whenever you want a snapshot of the business.

table.title: Recent sales
table.body: Latest invoices land here as you sell.

btn.title: View all
btn.body: Jump from this list into the full sales page.

filter.title: Purchases vs sales
filter.body: This chart is the month at a glance — buying versus selling, day by day.

nav.title: Products
nav.body: Inventory → Products. This is the catalog you sell from.

table.title: Product list
table.body: Every item, stock, and price in one table.

btn.title: Add product
btn.body: Use this to create a new item before you take a sale.

filter.title: Search and filters
filter.body: Search by name or SKU, or open filters to narrow the list.

nav.title: Customers
nav.body: People and businesses you sell to live under this sidebar link.

table.title: Customer list
table.body: Names, balances, and contact details in one table.

btn.title: Add customer
btn.body: Create a customer here, then pick them on a sale or at the POS.

filter.title: Search and filters
filter.body: Find a customer quickly, or filter by status.

nav.title: Sales
nav.body: Invoices and what customers owe — open it from the sidebar.

table.title: Sales list
table.body: Each row is an invoice. Open one to see lines and payments.

btn.title: New sale
btn.body: Create an invoice from here when it is not a walk-in POS sale.

filter.title: Search and filters
filter.body: Search invoices, or filter by status and date columns.

nav.title: POS register
nav.body: The walk-in counter. Open POS → Register from the sidebar.

table.title: Catalog
table.body: Tap a product to add it to the cart.

btn.title: Complete sale
btn.body: When the cart is ready, charge the customer with this button.

filter.title: Search catalog
filter.body: Type a name or SKU to find a product fast. Brand tabs sit just below.
